table.retrieve:
select  
	GroupType=Name5,
	GroupName=Name4,
	date=date1, 
	Category=Code1,
	ItemAlias=Name1,
	Item=Name2, 
	Supplier=Name3,
	InvoiceCode=Code3, 
	Rate=Value1,
	Qty=Value2, 
	PackUnits=Value3, 
	UTN=Value4,
	InvoiceCode1=Code5,
	Rate1=Value5,
	InvoiceCode2=Code6,
	Rate2=Value6,
	InvoiceCode3=Code7,
	Rate3=Value7,
	InvoiceCode4=Code8,
	Rate4=Value8,
	SalePrice = (SELECT Round(Item.SalePrice / 
							CASE :ar_purchasetype 
								WHEN 'P' THEN 1 
								ELSE 
									CASE Item.PackUnits 
										WHEN 0 THEN 1 
										ELSE Item.PackUnits 
									END 
							END, 2) 
					FROM Item 
					WHERE Item.ICode=ReportData.Code2)
from reportdata
ORDER BY GroupName, Item, Date, InvoiceCode
